notes: Reference numbers measured on a development machine with RTX 2080 Super.
These come from the volleyhub_fastpath_benchmark package, which uses
Ultralytics (model.predict) for inference and runs NMS in the packet.
The lab benchmark in this folder is intentionally lighter (raw TRT, no
NMS, no Ultralytics) and will report LARGER FPS numbers than the
baseline. The baseline is included so the tester can see the gap and
reason about how much of it the rest of the production app eats.
